objective_value: <float> Total expected cost, combining the fixed operating and start-up costs of all generators across all periods with the average production cost across scenarios.
x: <list[list[int]], shape [n_generators][T]> Whether each generator is running in each period (1 = running, 0 = off).
y: <list[list[int]], shape [n_generators][T]> Whether each generator is starting up in each period (1 = starting up, 0 = not).
y_bar: <list[list[int]], shape [n_generators][T]> Whether each generator is shutting down in each period (1 = shutting down, 0 = not).
q: <list[list[float]], shape [n_generators][T]> Start-up cost charged to each generator in each period.
p: <list[list[list[float]]], shape [n_generators][n_scenarios][T]> Power produced by each generator in each period under each demand scenario.
p_bar: <list[list[list[float]]], shape [n_generators][n_scenarios][T]> Available power capacity of each generator in each period under each demand scenario.
